entry_points.text: Sixty-four bit unsigned comparison orders by high half then low, returning zero, two or one for less, greater or equal without tracing. Unbounded signed string conversion delegates to a bounded worker with largest limit.

Early boot option enables a weak-hash debug flag persistently and reports success. A subsystem hook registers a one-shot entropy seeder. Mode handlers accept auto, never and always with fallback to auto, while a legacy handler forces persistent unhashed operation.

exports.text: Add, subtract and multiply share one path that suppresses repeats, selects signed wording, renders both operands and names destination type. Negation, division remainder and implicit conversion each add their own operand and flavor handling.

Two mismatch versions normalize to a common record before dispatch. Index handling names array type, shift checks four failure kinds in priority order, unreachable terminates, invalid load names expected type, and alignment derives actual stride from address bits.

Two-byte helpers bound length, scale size, copy with forced termination, compare lexicographically and transcode to one to three byte sequences within budget. User shims forward direction and return residual uncopied count.

Decimal conversion pads and reports length with empty on overflow. Unbounded formatting forwards to a bounded engine with a huge limit. Binary packing stores each argument word-aligned with capacity checks, inlining strings and deferring some pointers.
Anonymization reports busy while unseeded, otherwise stores a shortened stable identifier from keyed hashing. A one-shot hook seeds the secret from entropy during early bring-up.

Conditional update retries allocation, rejects advanced markers, normalizes absent markers and clears free mark on empty to occupied, while insertion reports busy on occupancy. Harvest copies present or marked entries up to a limit, succeeding immediately on empty requests. Diagnostic dump annotates levels with index and mark summaries.

Narrow and wide hashes use four lanes for longer inputs with striped accumulation and fusion, then tail mixing, length addition and avalanche. Reset installs seeds from leading primes, update extends state in call order, and digest yields current value without mutation.

hazards.text: Unreachable terminates after logging and never returns. Widest rendering needs very wide integer support or takes an internal warning path. Alignment diagnostics assume nonzero promise for mask computation. Combined shift violations report only the earliest in priority order.

Bounded copy truncates to room minus one with forced termination and too-big signalling. Zero checking can observe user faults and must propagate codes while closing access windows. Streaming update guards only input, so null state use would fault in either routine.

Callers must handle empty on decimal overflow, busy on unseeded hashing and occupied insertion, rejection of advanced markers, and silent truncation with retry skipping during harvest. Binary encoding truncates safely, preserves termination and alignment, and aborts cleanly on invalid conversions.

Finalization resolves automatic hashing from a debugging indicator. Disabled hashing exposes raw addresses through logging and triggers a prominent multi-line boot notice urging re-enablement unless actively debugging.

invariants.text: Suppression applies inside handling or after a site reported. The once marker shares storage with coordinates and is set atomically, so only the first hit emits output. A helper expands to a calling convention marker where needed.

Integer info packs signedness in the low bit and log width above, with inline fitting in a machine word. Helpers sign-extend narrow words, read wider values by width, test negativity only for signed, and render narrow decimal versus widest hex.
Find halves paths while climbing, union attaches by rank and bumps on tie. Zero checking masks edge bytes, scans word-wise, and reports all-zero, nonzero, or fault when the range cannot be read.

Random creation fills sixteen octets then stamps variant and version four at layout-specific offsets. Parsing validates hyphenated spelling then converts hex pairs through an index table, returning zero or invalid argument.

Presets cover plain string, prefixed lowercase hex, plain decimal and two and four wide padded counters. Restriction stays stable after early config. Window tracking keeps three timestamped candidates with reset on new extreme or full expiry.
Split order rounds down to chunk boundary except preserving zero. Total length accumulates across feeds and staged residue stays below a full group.

locks.text: Secret publication orders key store before readiness flag. Readers sample the flag with single access before sampling the key with acquire ordering.
Mark clearing pairs an unlocked worker with a locked wrapper. Harvest holds a read-side section and skips retry markers. Streaming hash uses no locks, so sharing one state needs caller exclusion.

state_machines.text: Sites test suppression, mark entry, log tag with masked coordinates, emit detail, then dump stack, close tracing, clear entry and evaluate escalation, taking no sleeping locks. Mismatch saves access state, selects null versus misaligned versus size case, then restores with paired windows.

Parser distinguishes plain, numeric, width, precision, character, string, pointer, escaped percent and invalid phases. Binary dispatch treats plain and escaped percent as no-ops, consumes integers for width and precision, separates character, string, pointer and numeric paths, and skips suffixes after pointer forms.

Window aging shifts on full expiry and captures middle and trailing choices after quarter and half intervals of stability. Cursor stepping adjusts index unless frozen, delegates empty positions to helpers, climbs on offset wrap and descends through interior nodes to a consumable entry.

structs.text: Diagnostics reserve forty bytes per operand. Checks enumerate about two dozen conditions with a small integer, float and unknown kind code. Wide aliases prefer very wide pairs, else sixty-four bit fallbacks. Header uses a guard macro.

Records pair locations with types and specifics: overflow one type, conversion two plus flavor, range array and index or two operand types, unreachable only location, and mismatch in current, legacy and normalized common shapes.

Conversion descriptor holds flags, base, limit and width packed without padding. Page flag descriptor groups width, shift, mask, preset and name in a static table for section, node, zone, CPU and tag.

Flags use single bits for signed, left, plus, space, zero pad, small and prefix. Width ceiling is two to twenty-three minus one, precision two to fifteen minus one. Control keeps a post-init show flag, an init-time auto or always or never policy, and one hundred decimal codes.
Null identifiers are zero filled. One table is identity, the other swaps order in the first three fields. Address value one marks deferred reclamation.

Narrow rotation is thirty-two bit and wide sixty-four with documented prime sets and little-endian selection per build. Narrow uses long path at sixteen bytes, wide at thirty-two, with specified round, fusion, tail and avalanche steps. State holds length, staged count, staging and four accumulators framed as thirty-two byte groups of four eight-byte lanes with eight, four and single tail steps and length folded.
